Market today: The tech and chip sectors are under significant pressure due to the Nvidia CEO scandal, creating major uncertainty. This, combined with extreme Dow volatility, means a very choppy market, especially for your concentrated book.

Your holdings: Many positions are in deep drawdown, particularly leveraged ETFs like SOXL (-74.99%), MUU (-58.32%), and SPAL (-43.54%). Your QQQ (-4.94%) is also nearing its stop. Margin amplifies these drops, making risk management critical.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Nvidia-related news and broader market volatility. Re-evaluate stops on your deeply negative leveraged positions.

Bottom line: Focus intensely on managing risk and protecting capital on your existing, highly concentrated, and leveraged positions.
plays: SOXL: Your stop at 200 is far from the current price of 56.2. Adjust this stop immediately to reflect current risk and protect capital.
MUU: Down 58%, your stop at 31.6 is also far off. Re-evaluate and tighten this stop to manage further losses.
QQQ: Watch your QQQ position closely as it approaches its stop at 670. Be ready to act if it breaks.
